answer: Sequential work puzzle with anchored beacons. Each identity registers by finding a partial hash collision over a beacon published every epoch, which costs real CPU hours but no money. A new signup must also consume a shale token emitted only to identities completing prior epochs, so registrations chain. The vine of valid history gates eligibility. An attacker needs one full CPU-day per identity plus a legitimate predecessor chain, making mass creation linearly expensive in hardware time.
